findings.evidence: In _append_event the early replay return matches on (evaluation_id, kind) for transitions and (invalidated_run_id, identity) for compensations without comparing the newly requested to_state/reason, so a caller submitting different arguments under the same key silently receives the first persisted ev
findings.title: Replay ignores newly requested state or reason

findings.evidence: The parametrized refusal tests cover dry_run/incomplete/mode and the happy path invalidates first; no test exercises the InvalidRunTransition('Compensation requires an invalidated run') branch inside _append_event for a valid evaluation run pointing at a run still in failed status.
findings.title: Compensation against a not-yet-invalidated run is untested
